phone_email_reference_checks.audit_scope: Nine declared PHONE/EMAIL synthetic vectors; independent syntax worksheet and stdlib parser cross-check; no production detector or validator invoked

method.phone: Strip only ASCII spaces/hyphens; remove a leading +52 if present; require exactly ten remaining ASCII digits. This audits declared format only; structure unknown and checksum not_applicable.
method.email: Independently apply one @, ASCII nonempty dot-atom local components, length <=64, at least two nonempty ASCII DNS labels without boundary hyphens, domain length <=253; cross-check with email.headerregistry.Address(addr_spec=value). Syntax structure only; delivery unknown.
method.sensitivity: Independent agent inspection of literal contexts against D2 receipt; exact attribution prefixes remove, explicitly documented nonpersonal software/exercise constants preserve, independently of syntax.
